newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bre-X to sack over 500 workers in Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X to sack over 500 workers in Indonesia.

text.p: Canadian exploration company Bre-X Minerals Ltd will sack most of its 549 employees in Indonesia following the Busang debacle, a company official said on Wednesday.
Bernhard Leode, chief financial officer of the company's Indonesian operations, said the employees would be paid compensation totalling $740,000 by the end of the month.
"Nearly 30 of the workers will be re-hired on a contract basis after the termination of services is completed," he told Reuters. "This includes six workers at Busang."
The Busang property was estimated by Bre-X to contain some 71 million ounces of gold, making it the century's biggest find. A later independent test showed it was almost worthless.
Consultant Strathcona Mineral Services Ltd found that data pegged to Busang was falsified on an unprecedented scale, making it the biggest mining fraud in history.
Indonesian authorities and the Royal Canadian Mounted Police are investigating the scandal.
